_source.description: 23-in x 74-in Black Light Filtering Room Darkening Cordless Roller Shade
_source.romanceCopy: The Mairo Made-to-Measure Roller Shade is a cordless, slow rising roller shade. It is a custom fit for your window, available in 1/2-inch increments, between 23 to 73 inches, measuring tip-to-tip. The cordless spring meets all guidelines for a child and pet safe environment. These roller shades are offered in both blackout and a light filtering fabric. All fabrics are 100 percent polyester coated with acrylic to give a smooth color and exquisite finish.
_source.parent_description: 74-in Light Filtering Cordless Roller shade Shade
_source.bullets_s: ["Cordless operation provides a child-safe and pet-safe environment", "Light filtering fabrics provide privacy and gently filter light, although darker light filtering fabrics will let through less light", "Cut-to-size; available in 1/2-inch increments, between 23 to 73 inches", "For inside mount order the same shade width as your window frame", "For outside mount its recommended to add a 3 inch overlap to window frame width", "Slow release spring design, offers a slow release when rolled up", "Durable, lightweight design with sturdy, premium metal components", "Includes all mounting hardware", "One-year limited warranty"]
